A fixed association-and-fusion pipeline incorporates each incoming RGB-D frame by updating matched objects or adding new ones. For ConceptGraphs, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of 3D object map.

derived.hybrid_relation: Geometric object state and the semantic-relational graph are linked in common object nodes and jointly support planning.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (3D object map) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
